title: Shavur Malka
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Shmuel and Rabbah are called this in Bava Batra 115b.
Pesachim 54a also calls Rava this. There is also Shavur Malka, king of Persia, who always spoke with Shmuel, as in Berakhot 56a, Moed Katan 26a, the end of Bava Metzia and Sanhedrin 98a.

notes.text: The rabbinic nickname and the Persian king are separate uses of the same designation. No particular historical ruler or identity merger is added.
